courses.name: Aerodynamics 1
courses.description: Aerodynamic forces and moments, aerodynamic-flow classification, governing equations, elementary potential flows, airfoil aerodynamics, boundary layers, low-speed wind-tunnel testing, and introductory CFD methods.

courses.name: Aircraft Operations and Flight Mechanics
courses.description: Fundamentals of aeronautical engineering, including aircraft aerodynamics, flight performance, aircraft operations, flight mechanics, accelerated flight, and introductory longitudinal stability.

courses.name: Aerodynamics 2
courses.description: Advanced aerodynamics topics building on Aerodynamics 1 within the Aerospace Engineering core curriculum.

courses.name: Aircraft Design
courses.description: Aircraft configuration and preliminary design to meet performance specifications, considering aerodynamics, stability and control, flying qualities, materials, systems engineering, and environmental factors.

courses.name: Computational Fluid Dynamics
courses.description: Computational techniques for aerospace engineering problems, including governing equations, discretization schemes, numerical methods, mesh quality, numerical errors, boundary conditions, and ANSYS Fluent practice.

courses.name: Selected Topics in Aerospace Engineering
courses.description: Selected topics aligned with student interests, faculty capabilities, and available resources in aerodynamics and flight mechanics.

courses.name: High-Temperature Gas Dynamics
courses.description: Equilibrium and nonequilibrium high-temperature gas behavior, real-gas properties, radiative energy exchange, and applications to re-entry dynamics, hypersonic flows, and plasma thrusters.

courses.name: Design and Critical Thinking in Aerospace Engineering
courses.description: Communication, design, and critical thinking in engineering, including problem identification, feasibility studies, preliminary design, technical writing, teamwork, presentations, and capstone project preparation.

courses.name: Capstone Engineering Design Project
courses.description: Detailed design and cost estimation for selected engineering solutions, with student teams developing original engineering designs, prototypes, and final reports.

courses.name: Design and Critical Thinking in Mechanical Engineering
courses.description: Communication, design, and critical thinking in mechanical engineering, including problem identification, feasibility studies, preliminary design, technical writing, teamwork, and formal presentations.

courses.name: Capstone Engineering Design Project
courses.description: Mechanical engineering capstone design course focused on detailed design, cost estimation, experimentation, modelling, simulation, data analysis, final reporting, and prototype development.

courses.name: Advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics
courses.description: Advanced CFD topics covering governing equations, finite-difference and finite-volume semi-discretization, time-integration stability, full-discretization accuracy and stability, and development of CFD codes.

graduationProjects.title: Design and Control of an Airship for Long-Endurance Flight
graduationProjects.description: Principal applied elements: airship design, performance analysis, control-system development, evaluation, and technical reporting.

graduationProjects.title: Development of a Quadplane VTOL System for Aerial Reconnaissance and Mapping
graduationProjects.description: Principal applied elements: VTOL design, system integration, analysis, testing, and application-oriented evaluation.

graduationProjects.title: Design and Optimization of a Quadplane for Improved Performance
graduationProjects.description: Principal applied elements: aircraft configuration development, performance analysis, optimization, evaluation, and documentation.

graduationProjects.title: Desktop Closed-Circuit Wind Tunnel with Closed-Loop Wind-Speed Control and Basic Test-Section Instrumentation
graduationProjects.description: Principal applied elements: experimental-system design, fabrication and development, closed-loop control, instrumentation, testing, and documentation.

exhibitions.title: Tech Expo 2024
exhibitions.description: Showcasing student projects in robotics and AI.
